article-meta.article-title: Archival Dispatch: 13 Master Broadcasts Dated Across Jackie Robinson Sports Interviews, Hank Snow Summer Shindig, and Dennis Day
article-meta.kwd-group: Jackie Robinson, Brooklyn Dodgers, Ralph Tiger Jones, Sugar Ray Robinson, Boxing History, Hank Snow, Rainbow Ranch Boys, Summer Shindig, Dennis Day, Bea Benaderet, Sharon Douglas, Dorothy Kilgallen, Winston Churchill, Pearl Bailey, American Forum of the Air, OPA Price Control, Jack Baker, Crazy Water Crystals, Purina Checkerboard Fun Fest, Original Filenames

sec.title: Batch 104 Forensic Discoveries
sec.p: Batch 104 recovers and dates 13 exceptional historic broadcasts spanning athletic legends, country music hall of famers, situation comedy masters, celebrity journalism, post-WWII economic debates, and vintage sponsored entertainment: baseball icon and civil rights pioneer Jackie Robinson interviewing middleweight boxer Ralph 'Tiger' Jones on ***Jackie Robinson's Radio Shots*** shortly after Jones' famous victory over Sugar Ray Robinson (1955), country music giant Hank Snow leading his Rainbow Ranch Boys on ***Summer Shindig*** (1963), 3 episodes of ***A Day in the Life of Dennis Day*** starring Dennis Day, Sharon Douglas, and voice acting legend Bea Benaderet (1948–1949), Broadway columnist Dorothy Kilgallen profiling Prime Minister Winston Churchill and singer Pearl Bailey on ***People You'd Like to Know*** (1954), the live debate on the fate of the Office of Price Administration on ***American Forum of the Air*** (June 1945), Jack Baker performing 'Chattanooga Shoe Shine Boy' (1950), Texas mineral water promotional fiddle breakdowns by ***The Crazy Hillbillies*** (1935), and 3 country variety half-hours from the Purina-sponsored ***Checkerboard Fun Fest*** (1946).
